notes: The base ground-cover unit, instanced by the tens of thousands, and the only asset in the library whose triangle count is a real budget rather than a rounding error. Nine blades, three segments, both windings — see src/assets/generators/grass.ts for why single-sided blades are not an option under a front-face-culled material.

rules.placement: Base ground-cover lattice — blanket meadows and sparse desert scrub; keep cheap and dense.
rules.avoid: Avoid alpine snow; coast strand keeps grassDensity at 0 on purpose.
